preconditions.description: The number of denominations n is between 2 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c[i] < c[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
preconditions.description: The denominations are in strictly increasing order.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c[i] <= 10**6 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each denomination is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'canonical' if all(greedy_coins(x) == optimal_coins(x) for x in range(2, c[-1] + c[-2])) else return_value == 'non-canonical'
postconditions.description: The coin system is 'canonical' if the greedy algorithm yields the optimal number of coins for all amounts less than the sum of the two largest denominations; otherwise, it is 'non-canonical'.
